content: We also perform a quantitative analysis of style transfer by generating BLEU scores for the model output using the style transfer dataset. The variation of the BLEU scores with the source sentence lengths is shown in Figure FIGREF11. As expected, the BLEU scores decrease with increase in source sentence lengths.
